Influence of hot isostatic pressing on mechanical response of as-built SLM titanium alloy

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Peripheral Skim only mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Michaela Roudnická, Kateřina Mertová, Dalibor Vojtěch IOP Conference Series Materials Science and Engineering 2019-09-01 10.1088/1757-899x/629/1/012034
单位: Department of Metals and Corrosion Engineering, University of Chemistry and technology Prague, Technicka 5, 166 28 Prague 6, Czech Republic
通讯: Michaela Roudnická @ Department of Metals and Corrosion Engineering, University of Chemistry and technology Prague, Technicka 5, 166 28 Pragu
相关性: 该论文研究了选择性激光熔化Ti6Al4V合金的热等静压处理对力学性能的影响，涉及静态和疲劳测试，但与应力遮挡或多孔结构无直接关联。
边界: Paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding, does not report surface roughness or osseointegration, and lacks biomedical context.
动机· 评估热等静压对选区激光熔化Ti6Al4V合金力学性能的改善效果
方法· 对as-built试样进行HIP处理，对比未处理和常规热处理，测试微观结构、静态力学和疲劳性能
结果· HIP可提高疲劳极限，但受限于粗糙表面，静态性能变化不大
验证· 通过拉伸和疲劳试验验证力学性能变化
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate whether hot isostatic pressing can mitigate the detrimental effect of rough as-built surfaces on the fatigue performance of selective laser melted Ti6Al4V.
Method· As-built SLM Ti6Al4V specimens were subjected to HIP and conventional heat treatment, then characterized by microstructure analysis, tensile tests, and high-cycle fatigue tests.
Result· HIP improved the fatigue limit compared to untreated condition, but the rough surface still limited the full benefit, while static mechanical properties were comparable.
Validation· Experimental validation through standardized mechanical testing (tensile and fatigue) on machined specimens.

SLM Ti6Al4V hot isostatic pressing fatigue additive manufacturing

通讯: E. V. Borisov @ Peter the Great St.Petersburg Polytechnic University
相关性: 该论文通过SLM和HIP处理晶格结构，探索与骨骼匹配的力学性能，直接相关于你的生物医学植入物方向。

方法· 使用SLM制造晶格结构，部分试样进行HIP处理，测试力学性能和微观结构
结果· SLM晶格结构精度高，HIP处理显著改善力学性能，接近皮质骨水平

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the properties of lattice structures produced by selective laser melting and evaluate the effect of hot isostatic pressing for biomedical applications.
Method· Lattice structures were fabricated by SLM and subjected to HIP, followed by characterization of microstructure and mechanical properties.
Result· SLM lattices exhibited high dimensional accuracy and HIP treatment improved mechanical performance to levels comparable with cortical bone.
Validation· Mechanical compression testing and microstructural analysis were conducted for validation.

Motivation· The motivation is to develop a bioink that mimics the extracellular matrix microenvironment while possessing suitable rheological properties for 3D bioprinting.
Method· The method involves modifying extracellular matrix components (hyaluronic acid, gelatin) with gallol moieties to create dynamic hydrogen bonds for shear-thinning and auto-oxidative covalent crosslinking for stabilization.
Result· The gallol-modified hydrogel ink exhibits excellent printability, cytocompatibility (~95% viability), and on-tissue printability due to adhesion, with printed constructs showing degradation and cell spreading over 6 days.
Validation· Validation was performed through extrusion-based 3D bioprinting and subsequent cell viability and culture assays.

结果· 生产率年均增长1.4%，效率改善贡献大于技术进步。
验证· 基于多个注册数据库的纵向研究。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To analyze productivity changes in total hip arthroplasty provision in Sweden from 2005 to 2012.
Method· Malmquist Productivity Index was applied to department-level cost and procedure data from 65 orthopaedic departments.
Result· Productivity increased by an average of 1.4% per year, driven mainly by efficiency improvements rather than technical change.
Validation· Multiple registry-based longitudinal study with statistical significance testing.

Matt Carstens, Michelle D. Kofron, James Reams, Hai Wen Clinical Oral Implants Research 2019-09-01 10.1111/clr.101_13509
单位: Zimmer Biomet, United States
通讯: Matt Carstens @ Zimmer Biomet, United States
相关性: 该论文研究牙科种植体-基台界面的微动，与髋关节假体应力遮挡和股骨柄稳定性无关。
边界: This paper focuses on dental implant-abutment micromotion, not on hip implant stress shielding, femoral stem mechanics, or proximal femur bone remodeling.
动机· 评估不同品牌基台与种植体连接的稳定性
方法· 测量旋转自由度、拔出力及模拟咀嚼下的微动
结果· 原厂基台稳定性显著优于副厂基台
验证· 机械测试与截面观察
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the connection stability between genuine and aftermarket abutments when used with a specific dental implant system.
Method· Rotational freedom, pull force, and micromotion under simulated chewing were measured for different abutment groups.
Result· Genuine abutments exhibited significantly higher stability and smaller gaps compared to aftermarket abutments.
Validation· Mechanical testing including torque loss, rotational freedom, pull force, and micromotion quantification.

Curative effect of surgery within 48 hours after hip fracture in elderly patients

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore none
Jian Li, Liuhui Chang, Qi Gu, Gongwen Liu, Yan Gao et al. Zhonghua guke zazhi 2019-09-01 10.3760/cma.j.issn.0253-2352.2019.17.001
单位: Department of Orthopaedics, The Second Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University, Suzhou, 215004, China
通讯: Jian Li @ Department of Orthopaedics, The Second Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University, Suzhou, 215004, China
相关性: 该论文仅关注老年髋部骨折手术时机对临床预后的影响，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物设计。
边界: This paper is purely clinical, with no biomechanical modeling, no stress/strain analysis, no micromotion, no FEA, and no implant design.
动机· 比较老年髋部骨折48小时内与48小时后手术的临床效果。
方法· 回顾性分析47例患者，分为48小时内和48小时后手术组，比较住院时间、费用、并发症和Harris评分。
结果· 48小时内手术组住院时间更短、费用更低、早期并发症更少、Harris评分更高。
验证· 临床随访12-24个月，比较两组数据。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare clinical outcomes of hip fracture surgery performed within versus after 48 hours in elderly patients.
Method· A retrospective study of 47 patients divided into two groups based on surgery timing, analyzing length of stay, cost, complications, and Harris hip scores.
Result· Surgery within 48 hours resulted in shorter hospitalization, lower cost, fewer early complications, and better Harris scores at 1 month.
Validation· Clinical follow-up over 12-24 months with statistical comparison between groups.

An innovative self‐tapping underprepared implant‐ in vivo histologic and histomorphometric analysis

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore animal Exp. validation
Marco Berardini, Paolo Trisi, Antonello Falco Clinical Oral Implants Research 2019-09-01 10.1111/clr.184_13509
单位: Private Practice, Italy
通讯: Marco Berardini @ Private Practice, Italy
相关性: 该论文研究牙科种植体，而非髋关节植入物，与用户研究方向无关。
边界: This paper focuses on dental implants in sheep iliac crest, not on femoral stem hip implants, and does not quantify proximal femur stress shielding, micromotion with contact modeling, or compare intact vs implanted femur.
动机· 评估自攻种植体在低密度骨中单钻植入的可行性
方法· 在羊髂骨上比较单钻与标准序列钻孔后种植体的骨整合
结果· 单钻组骨接触率和骨体积显著高于对照组
验证· 动物实验结合组织形态学和生物力学测量
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate whether a self-tapping implant placed with an underprepared drilling protocol can achieve comparable osseointegration to standard preparation in low-density bone.
Method· In a sheep iliac crest model, implants were placed using either a single pilot drill (test) or a standard sequential drilling protocol (control), and histomorphometric and biomechanical outcomes were compared after 2 months.
Result· The test group showed significantly higher bone-to-implant contact (70.91% vs 49.33%) and peri-implant bone volume (41.83% vs 29.61%) than the control group.
Validation· Validation was performed via in vivo animal experiment with histomorphometric analysis (BIC, BV) and biomechanical tests (micromotion, reverse torque, ISQ).
